name: hitch
description: Plan trips collaboratively with hitch. Connects the hitch MCP server and adds skills for building an itinerary, logging bookings, briefing a trip, and working the pre-departure list.

interface.longDescription: hitch is a collaborative trip planner. This plugin connects its MCP server and adds the workflows around it: starting a trip with the destination pinned so the map and weather work, filling in days from a saved shortlist, turning pasted confirmations into bookings with the times printed on the ticket, briefing where a trip stands, and working the pre-departure list. Trips are shared and edited concurrently, so the skills carry the discipline that keeps a collaborator's edits from being overwritten.
defaultPrompt: Start a trip to Kyoto, 12-18 April
Show me where my Kyoto trip stands
Log this booking confirmation into my trip
